channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: STF tira federação PSDB-Cidadania de coligação de Raquel Lyra em Pernambuco
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Dias Toffoli ordered the removal of the PSDB-Cidadania Federation from Raquel Lyra's coalition in Pernambuco. Lyra's campaign announced it will appeal the court ruling.

item.title: Dino usa precedente sobre liberdade de imprensa para liberar posts sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino used a press freedom precedent to allow posts regarding an alleged plot by candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to remove the title of Patroness of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida. Bolsonaro denied any intention to take such action.

item.title: Lula defende revogação do Fundo Eleitoral para encerrar a 'promiscuidade política'
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated for the revocation of the Electoral Fund to combat 'political promiscuity', arguing that current legislation allows corrupt and unequal campaign financing practices. He proposes changes to electoral regulation to increase transparency.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro se diz 'perplexa' com decisão de Dino sobre posts de Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino's decision to remove posts featuring Our Lady containing allegedly offensive statements. The statement expressed concern over religious censorship and defended freedom of expression.

item.title: Em agenda, Cappelli promete isenção de IPVA para motoristas de aplicativos
item.description: Ricardo Cappelli (PSB) pledged IPVA exemption and a GDF-owned app, Bora DF, with maximum 10% trip fees for ride-hailing and delivery drivers. He also proposed vehicle insurance through Banco de Brasília and cooperative management of the platform.

item.title: Lula defende acabar com fundo eleitoral para Brasil ter "política sadia"
item.description: President Lula advocates for abolishing the electoral fund and enacting comprehensive political reform to strengthen parties with ethics and programs. He also proposes a special police force and the National Force to combat organized crime, especially high-level crime.

item.title: Veja como foi o final de semana dos candidatos à presidência
item.description: On the 26th and 27th, the presidential candidates held street events across the country, with special emphasis on Lula, who defended the ban on online betting and criticized agribusiness; Zema and Caiado also campaigned in Minas Gerais and Goiás, addressing rural credit and religious freedom.

item.title: "Ou acabava com as bets, ou elas acabavam com o povo", afirma Leandro Grass
item.description: Leandro Grass, PT candidate for DF governor, supports Lula's ban on bets, claiming it prevented family debt. Celina Leão, DF governor and PP re-election candidate, criticized the measure as political opportunism. The provisional measure signed by Lula provides for the return of R$1.7 billion to bettors and the end of sports betting in the country.

item.title: Confira todos os vencedores do fim de semana no Autódromo de Brasília
item.description: Over the weekend at Brasília International Track, Sérgio Sette Câmara and Lucas di Grassi won the Stock Car endurance race, while Gabriel Koenigkan secured the Stock Light championship. The event also featured Formula 4 and Turismo Nacional categories, with wins going to Fausto Arnaudo, Bernardo Gentil, João Cardoso, and Luiz Veras.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio liga fake news da padroeira a criador de Dilma Bolada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign accuses Jeferson de Oliveira Monteiro, creator of the 'Dilma Bolada' profile, of leading a disinformation campaign about an alleged proposal to remove Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Patroness of Brazil. The complaint cites 29 profiles and requests an investigation by the Electoral Prosecutor's Office for possible electoral crimes.

item.title: Lula defende a criação de uma ‘polícia especial’ contra o crime organizado
item.description: President Lula advocated for the creation of a 'special police' force and a Ministry of Public Security to combat organized crime, describing criminal factions as 'a multinational industry'. He proposed economically strangling these groups and targeting their leadership, which he claims is infiltrated in institutions such as the judiciary, police, and politics.

item.title: Os temas abordados por Lula em programa eleitoral na reta final da campanha
item.description: Lula released an electoral program comparing himself to Flávio Bolsonaro and emphasizing measures for workers, such as rest time, education, and cost of life reduction. Each letter of 'Lula' symbolizes proposals like fighting violence, universal education, and salary increase. The speech extends beyond partisan identity, emphasizing trust in the country.

item.title: Lula defende ‘polícia especial’ contra o crime organizado e fim do Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: Lula proposed creating a federal special police to combat organized crime and a dedicated ministry for public security, criticizing previous military interventions. He advocated for the revocation of the Electoral Fund, arguing that U.S. state terrorism should not be confused with tackling Brazilian criminal factions.

item.title: Lula muda ato na Bahia e PT baiano atribui decisão a Janja
item.description: Lula's campaign moved the final event in Bahia from Feira de Santana to Salvador, focusing on capital cities. The decision was attributed to First Lady Janja by PT members, opposing a faction that supported keeping the event in Feira de Santana.

item.title: Fake news contra Flávio é sinal da “degradação moral” do PT, diz Moro
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) accused the PT of spreading fake news claiming Flávio Bolsonaro aims to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patron saint, labeling it a sign of 'moral degradation' of Lula and his party.

item.title: Ministros do Supremo avançam sobre questões eleitorais e ‘atropelam’ TSE em ao menos 4 decisões
item.description: Supreme Court ministers, including Flávio Dino, Gilmar Mendes, and Alexandre de Moraes, have been making decisions on electoral matters ahead of the TSE, increasing tensions within the Court. Minister Dino recently annulled a TSE ruling that had ordered the removal of posts falsely linking senator Flávio Bolsonaro to a legislative bill. These actions reflect an institutional conflict between the STF and TSE, exacerbated by allegations such as the Banco Master case.

item.title: Rogério Marinho esboça planos no Senado em caso de vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, discusses the possibility of running for Senate presidency in case of victory at the Planalto Palace. He highlights priorities such as reform of the Judiciary, term limits for Supreme Court ministers, and impeachment proceedings against magistrates. Marinho also proposes changes to the Senate's internal rules to facilitate the opening of inquiries and responsibility processes against judges.

item.title: Fundo de florestas de Lula bate US$ 7,3 bi com aporte britânico
item.description: The TFFF (Tropical Forests Forever Fund) reached $7.3 billion after the UK announced an investment of £400 million. Created by Brazil at COP30, the fund aims to raise $10 billion by December 31, 2025 to activate initial investments, with participation from Norway, Germany, and France.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tenta reeditar motociatas do pai, mas expõe rachas do bolsonarismo em Sergipe
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a motorcycle rally in Sergipe to rally support from Bolsonarismo, but the event highlighted internal divisions within the PL. The absence of key local slate figures and Coronel Rocha's public discomfort revealed tensions over campaign funding and party alliances.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio acusa Dino de usurpar função do TSE após liberar publicações sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino's decision to allow social media posts about the law establishing Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, claiming it oversteps the TSE's role. The campaign's legal team acknowledged freedom of expression but questioned the Supreme Court's interference in electoral matters.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio se diz ‘perplexa’ com decisão que liberou posts sobre falso ataque à padroeira
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino's decision allowing the return of false posts claiming he would remove Our Lady of Aparecida from her status as patron saint, expressing bewilderment over the STF's actions. The false story, originating from a pro-government influencer, spread rapidly with over 1 million posts in less than three days before being corrected by media outlets.

item.title: Haddad sai em defesa de Lula e diz que presidente queria estabelecer regras sobre bets desde 2024
item.description: Fernando Haddad defended Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, claiming the president had advocated for regulations on online betting since 2024. He emphasized that the federal government recently sent a decree to completely ban bets in the country. Haddad also highlighted joint operations by the Federal Revenue and Federal Police against the use of bets for money laundering and currency evasion.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest testa disputa Lula x Flávio após veto às bets na reta final para o primeiro turno
item.description: The final Quaest poll before the first round will be released on October 3rd and tests the electoral race, including a simulated second-round matchup between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro. The survey will examine voting intentions, voter firmness, the impact of the Globo presidential debate, and potential vote shifts.

item.title: Caiado critica ‘enfrentamento religioso’ após notícia falsa citando Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: Caiado criticizes religious confrontation in the campaign and defends that electoral disputes should not politicize faith after a false news involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida.

item.title: Lula tenta ampliar voto ao dizer que eleitor não precisa “fazer o L”
item.description: Lula released first-round campaign ad stating voters do not need to 'do the L' or wear red to support Brazil's progress. The ad covers cost of living, 6x1 work schedule, education, and taxation, targeting undecided young voters. The campaign also attacks Flávio Bolsonaro over militia connections.

item.title: Vídeo lembra mortes da pandemia e recomenda: “Outro Bolsonaro, não”
item.description: Minister Fernanda Machiaveli released a critical video targeting former President Jair Bolsonaro and his son Flávio Bolsonaro, linking past administration actions to the deaths during the covid-19 pandemic, which claimed over 700,000 lives in Brazil. Using AI-generated imagery, the content highlights issues such as vaccination, weapons, violence, and tariffs, while repeating the slogan 'No more Bolsonaro,' positioning itself against the continuation of the Bolsonaro family's political legacy in national governance.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da decisão de Dino que libera post sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino overturned a decision by André Mendonça that had suspended a post by humorist Antônio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida. Mendonça had blocked the publication deeming it harmful to Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy.

item.title: Os argumentos de Dino para derrubar decisão de Mendonça sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino overturned a decision by André Mendonça ordering the removal of posts about Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida, citing risks to freedom of speech and religion. The case involved comedian Antônio Tabet's criticism of a bill challenging the Patroness of Brazil, sparking debate on free expression and electoral boundaries.

item.title: Em ato na Catedral da Sé, Haddad diz que Flávio Bolsonaro tem postura de intolerância religiosa
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT candidate for São Paulo governor, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for a posture of religious intolerance at a public event in the Cathedral of São Paulo. The attack occurred during a speech, highlighting ideological differences between the candidates.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama Lula novamente de 'pai do Tigrinho' em Sergipe
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro referred to Lula as 'papa tigre' during a campaign rally in Sergipe, reviving a controversial jab tied to the 'tiger cub' fraud scheme. The incident underscores the confrontational tone of the 2026 presidential race, with direct attacks against the opponent.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama Lula de ‘pai do Tigrinho’ e diz que petista quer jogar pobre ‘na miséria’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro called Lula 'father of Tigrinho' and criticized the legalization of online betting, promising investments in Sergipe and criticizing the PT. He used a truck to say the PT keeps the poor in misery and made references to a possible DNA test to prove a connection with 'Tigrinho'.

item.title: O argumento de Dino para sustentar decisão sobre Nossa Senhora de Fátima
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino ruled against restricting comedian Antonio Tabet, stating that criticism of designating Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint should be protected under free speech. The decision overturned TSE orders requiring post removal and imposing a fine of R$ 30,000.

item.title: Mais uma gambiarra de Dino
item.description: Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino overturned a colleague's decision for the second time in weeks using an old case, drawing criticism over the Court's functioning.

item.title: O conselho que Fachin recebeu – e ignorou – no caso de Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin decided to schedule the session regarding Alexandre de Moraes' investigation for October 15th, disregarding advice to delay it after the elections. The decision arises amid a scandal involving message exchanges with banker Daniel Vorcaro, whose documents reached the STF through a legal operation. Leaked data reveals a close relationship between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and Vorcaro, which may influence Congress's stance on potential ministerial impeachment.

item.title: Nossa senhora: Tabet celebra decisão de Dino e anuncia republicação de post
item.description: Comedian Antônio Tabet praised Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino's decision to overturn the removal order of a post about Our Lady of Aparecida, stating it preserved freedom of expression and religion. Tabet announced he would republish the content, which had been taken down following an action by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The post criticized the so-called 'military family' for allegedly attacking the image of Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: Governistas querem tornar patrimônio cultural o culto a Nossa Senhora
item.description: Federal deputies Chico Alencar and Rogério Correia introduced a bill to designate the devotion to Our Lady of Aparecida as intangible cultural heritage, responding to rumors about her status as patroness. The proposal follows Flávio Bolsonaro filing complaints against 29 individuals for spreading electoral misinformation, using the initiative to highlight the role of tradition in national culture and the defense of a secular and plural state.

item.title: JB Carvalho defendeu em livro retirar NS Aparecida como padroeira do Brasil
item.description: JB Carvalho defended in 2001 book removing Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, distinct from fake news about Flávio Bolsonaro. The pastor recorded his position in 'A Bomba', questioning legality of holiday and calling for parliamentary mobilization. Flávio and family maintain relationship with the church founded by Carvalho.

item.title: Leia a íntegra de decisão de Dino que liberou posts sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: STF minister Flávio Dino overturned a decision ordering the removal of posts critical of Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida, ensuring freedom of expression and religion. The ruling responded to a appeal by comedian Antônio Tabet, targeted by a representation from the PL after a controversial post.

item.title: TRT proíbe empresa de promover atos de campanha após almoço com Bia Kicis
item.description: Labor courts banned Sementes Três Pinheiros Seeds Ltda from promoting campaign activities after a lunch with Bia Kicis, who solicited votes during the event. The Public Ministry of Labor notified the company and obtained an injunction with daily fines of R$50,000 for non-compliance. The practice may constitute electoral harassment.

item.title: Gestora da Stock Car projeta R$ 500 milhões em faturamento em até três anos
item.description: Grupo Veloci projects revenue of R$500 million within three years, with Stock Car Pro Series expected to generate R$230 million in 2026. Brazilian motorsport grows through sponsorships and events at Nelson Piquet International Raceway, featuring renowned drivers like Felipe Massa and Lucas Di Grassi.

item.title: Bets: proibir não significa acabar com uma prática, mas torná-la ilegal
item.description: President Lula announced the ban on sports betting via 'bets', driven by electoral pressures and public rejection of the sector's rapid growth. The previous legalization aimed to regulate the market under state control but led to widespread presence of betting companies, social harm, and revenue leakage to tax havens. Critics question the lack of serious planning and the risks of criminalization without effective oversight.

item.title: Lives, cola na mão e leite condensado: Flávio incorpora símbolos de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has adopted visual and behavioral elements associated with his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, such as handwritten messages, crowd interactions, and symbolic gestures, aiming to consolidate the bolsonarista electorate ahead of the 2026 election. His strategy includes public appearances echoing his father's iconic moments and direct communication through live streams, reinforcing the narrative of political continuity. Analysts note that Flávio blends identification with his father while cultivating a softer, more unifying image compared to polarized rhetoric.

item.title: Lula chega à reta final sem impulso de popularidade visto em presidentes candidatos à reeleição
item.description: Lula enters the final stretch of the campaign without the typical popularity boost seen in previous reelection bids. Polls show government approval around 33% with no significant rise, unlike FHC, Dilma, and Bolsonaro. Political scientists cite economic and communication factors as reasons.

item.title: Flávio tem apoio discreto no meio artístico na disputa de 2026
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to secure public endorsements from artists, unlike Lula who received over 100. Some endorsements are indirect or symbolic, such as a video from singer Leonardo and Neymar signing a jersey. He also received support from digital influencers.

item.title: Comício de Lula toca “Nossa Senhora” em meio à fake news sobre Flávio
item.description: During a rally in São Miguel, São Paulo, Lula's campaign played 'Nossa Senhora' amid controversy over fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro. The song was used before the PT candidate's walk, sparking debates about the use of pop culture in electoral campaigns.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram números de Lula nos levantamentos da última semana
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro in first-round polls from last week but ties technically in second-round simulations. Rejection of Lula reaches 49%. Poll numbers show slight swings within the margin of error for both candidates.

item.title: Dino reverte decisão de Mendonça sobre fake news de Nossa Senhora
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino overturned a decision by André Mendonça at the TSE, keeping suspended a post by comedian Antonio Tabet that spread a fake news story about Our Lady of Aparecida, shared by Lula supporters. The ruling aims to protect free speech and prevent religious misinformation.

item.title: Saiba como as bets adoeceram e endividaram os brasileiros
item.description: The ban on online betting in Brazil brought relief to cases like Kaio's, who lost his car, home and job due to gambling addiction. MP 1394 revoked provisions of Law 13.756, which had regulated online betting five years after its initial approval, highlighting the social and psychological impact of the practice.

item.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça que removeu posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio a ‘tirar padroeira’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino overturned a TSE decision that had ordered the removal of fake posts claiming Senator Flávio Bolsonaro supported a bill to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of her title as Brazil’s patron saint. The false story, widely shared online, was first reported by a TV network and later corrected, but it sparked backlash and mutual accusations among candidates. It ranks as the third-largest misinformation episode in the 2026 election cycle.

item.title: Ato da esquerda em SP adota discurso religioso após disputa sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Left-wing candidates in São Paulo held a Mass at the Cathedral and a women's rally, highlighting religion in the political agenda amid debates over Our Lady of Aparecida. The strategy aims to connect the Catholic conservative base with progressive demands.
